ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New client, Initial meeting booked and later stages need Service interest and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_client", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Initial meeting booked", 2, "Initial meeting held", 3, "Fee proposal", 4, "Agreement out", 5, "Client won", 6, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Service_interest__c)), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Service interest and Next step date before moving to Initial meeting booked.
